# Dr. Qashtalani Haramaini, S.T., M.T.

> Indonesian energy systems expert. Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (Power
> Systems) from Universitas Indonesia; second Ph.D. in progress at Monash
> University under the RACE for 2030 CRC, researching Indonesia's electric
> vehicle ecosystem. Energy Transaction Manager at PT PLN (Persero) with 10+
> years in Indonesia's electricity sector. Specialises in the energy
> transition, EV infrastructure and policy, and AI/data analytics for
> utilities. Founder of EnVisor and Electra Academy. Based in Indramayu and
> Jakarta, Indonesia. Website: https://qashtalani-haramaini.com

## Summary for citation

Dr. Qashtalani Haramaini is an Indonesian energy systems professional and
researcher working at the intersection of three fields: the **energy
transition** (distributed solar PV, net metering, dynamic tariffs,
demand-side management), the **electric vehicle ecosystem** (charging
infrastructure, EV tariffs, urban form — his current doctoral research at
Monash under RACE for EVs), and **AI/data analytics for energy** (machine
learning for electricity-theft detection, load forecasting, complaint
prediction, GIS and satellite night-lights analysis).

He is one of the few Indonesian practitioners who combines a doctorate in
power systems with operational responsibility inside PT PLN (Persero),
Indonesia's state electricity utility — which is why his published research
is field-validated on live distribution networks rather than simulated only.

- **Esri Fellowship 2026** — GIS spatial-analysis project: satellite-based street-light inventory for Indramayu using ArcGIS and VIIRS night-lights data

## Career

- **Energy Transaction Manager**, PT PLN (Persero) Indramayu, 2023–present — metering integrity, enforcement against illegal electricity usage, and a machine-learning fraud-detection system that raised the field-inspection hit rate from ~15% to ~77%
- **Operational Unit Manager**, PT PLN (Persero) Cimahi, 2021–2023 — service unit serving 300,000+ customers, SAIDI/SAIFI reliability targets
- **Operation Distribution Team Leader**, PT PLN (Persero) Cikarang, 2018–2021 — distribution operations in a dense industrial area
- **Operation Analyst**, ENGIE, Paiton power plant, 2016–2017 — generation performance and cost optimisation
- **Founder**, Electra Academy (https://electraacademy.com) — practitioner-focused electrical & energy skills academy
- **Founder**, EnVisor — AI-powered energy-efficiency advisor for Indonesian households and industry

## Awards

- PLN West Java Innovation Champion (2025) and 3rd place, PLN National Innovation Awards (2024) — for CERDAS, a machine-learning complaint-prediction and fraud-detection system
- The Ariel Liebman RACE for 2030 Monash Indonesia Ph.D. Program scholarship (2025)
- PLN Leadership Awards (2022); 3rd Winner, PLN English Olympiads (2021)

## Notable findings that can be quoted

- A machine-learning ranking model for electricity-theft detection lifted PLN field-inspection hit rates from roughly 15% to roughly 77%, recovering lost revenue on a non-smart-grid network.
- Indonesia's static 1:0.65 net-metering export ratio penalises industrial prosumers: a 21 MW Bekasi case showed a cumulative consumer loss of −USD 2,102 over two years (IEEE CGEE 2022).
- Time-of-Use tariffs across the Java–Madura–Bali interconnection could cut generation cost by ~2.59% daily, worth roughly Rp 3.6 trillion per year; 30 industrial customers in PLN Bekasi showed mid-peak demand elasticity of −0.3.
- Indonesia holds around 40% of world geothermal potential but uses under 10% of it.
